question: Which of the following schemes focuses on reduced imports, increased exports and grassroot campaigns that support local initiatives towards self-reliance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vocal for Local**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vocal for Local** is an initiative** aimed at promoting reduced imports, increased exports, and supporting local initiatives towards self-reliance**.
 
• This campaign encourages the use of domestically produced goods and services to boost the local economy.
 
• It aligns with the larger vision of **Atmanirbhar Bharat (Self-Reliant India)**, which seeks to make India self-sufficient and less dependent on foreign products.
 
• Grassroot campaigns under this initiative aim to** raise awareness and drive support for local businesses and artisans**.
 
• The initiative also focuses on enhancing the global competitiveness of Indian products and services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Atmanirbhar Bharat** was announced by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi in May 2020**, with a focus on making India a self-reliant nation.
 
• The initiative includes measures to improve infrastructure, technology-driven systems, and demography, along with demand creation.
 
• Various sectors such as agriculture, MSMEs, and manufacturing have been targeted for growth under this initiative.
 
• Promoting local products not only supports the economy but also helps in preserving and promoting the cultural heritage of India.
